goal: Guest scans a QR code on a numbered umbrella / sunbed and sends a kitchen/bar request assigned to that spot.
requested_workflow: Owner defines areas and numbered umbrellas / tables
Each spot receives a unique QR link or token
Guest scans and sees venue menu for current service times
Guest selects products and quantity, adds notes and allergens info
Guest reviews item totals and confirms an order request
Server rechecks prices, product availability and spot token
Bar/kitchen receives queued order, staff accepts or rejects
Guest sees accepted / preparing / ready / delivered status
Staff delivers to the correct numbered beach umbrella
Owner closes service session and reviews performance

spot_model.display_code: e.g. U-023 (only example, not assigned at Calma)
spot_model.qr_token: random opaque token mapped to spot_id (no personal data embedded)

order_model.guest_data_minimization: No guest name or phone needed for on-site order if staff can deliver by spot and order ID.

safeguards: Operator approval and onboarding before deployment
Only operator can configure active menu and prices
Server-side order and spot validation; never trust browser totals
Prevent multiple accidental submissions, include rate-limits
Staff capacity controls and availability toggles
Allergen information requires owner verification; guest can ask staff
Age and legal compliance when alcohol is ordered
Privacy notice and secure transport; role-based staff permissions
Offline or bad-signal fallback: call waiter / standard ordering
Stop orders outside confirmed service hours / when venue closed
No payments or inventory reservations until the live backend is implemented
deployment_phases: Phase 2: operator-approved QR + order-request backend (no online payment)
Phase 3: kitchen/bar workflow, real-time updates, optional payment
current_blockers: Owner agreement to accept digital orders
